statusNote: On 2026-10-15 the creator approved the science sphere: New York City as the science hub (playable scene: City Hall Park, Lower Manhattan), Yonkers, New York as the outskirts, the whole of Washington, D.C. as abandoned ruins centred on the U.S. Capitol grounds, and a first air route New York City-Chicago with one playable Chicago Loop district. The science sphere covers the US and Canada only. The place set is approved; every route figure is still a preliminary estimate, and nothing here marks M2 accepted. The provisional v01 Shanghai set is kept as hidden retiredLocations so old saves still load; Liangzhu is later Asia work.

attribution.note: Provenance metadata only; the game runtime does not read it. Every coordinateSource and segment source names a sourceId listed here. licenseStatus 'needs-verification' means the reuse terms are believed open but were not confirmed from the publisher's own terms page. Check them before packaging. This is a project record, not legal advice.

calendar.note: The creator set the start date 2537-05-25 (a Saturday in the proleptic Gregorian calendar the game uses). 08:00 is an engineering placeholder for the time of day. New runs start here. Saves keep their absolute date, so a save made with the 2026-04-01 placeholder still shows its 2026 date after loading; nothing is shifted.
